semantic_diff.detail: Pre-core literal /map_server and /amcl names are represented by equal-valued dataclass fields.
Navigation active_nodes must include canonical /map_server, /amcl, and /move_base. /move_base was already required; map_server and AMCL are newly explicit.
Native and integrated navigation reject /slam_gmapping, /cartographer_node, and /robot_pose_ekf.
Canonical instance checks now cover /map_server and /amcl in addition to the existing /limo_base_node and /move_base checks; canonical underscore aliases are rejected.

explicitly_unchanged: goal, cancel, status, feedback, and result ownership
READY, guard, stop, and cancel semantics
known_scope_limits: canonical alias matching is intentionally limited to canonical_name plus underscore
the policy does not attribute individual TF edges to publishers
the policy does not validate the external vendor limo_start.launch bytes
offline topology PASS does not close runtime ownership
blocking_reasons: individual TF edges are not yet attributed to caller authority and transport topic
cross-/tf and /tf_static duplicate edges are not yet rejected by the frozen policy
dynamic versus static edge behavior is not yet machine-validated
vendor limo_start.launch bytes and recursive include chain remain unverified
post-change full bridge and secure-validator regression has not passed
